confidence_notes: Food, coffee, and beer estimates use Havana aggregate price observations from 2026 and approximate the July pricing window. comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used. Food and drink estimates use Havana's own aggregate price data; lodging is estimated for Havana's visitor market.
